metric: Within-query-position mean scan error, then pool the selected task position_errors. P90 is the linear 0.9 quantile of that pooled array. Repeats and calibration budgets remain separate.

wknn_S.label: WKNN(S)
wknn_S.training_information: No learned source model. Matching and coordinate bounds use target S.

gp_S.label: GP(S)
gp_S.training_information: Hyperparameters calibrated on the other UJI buildings. Target field fits S. Deployment H/S determine AP availability and coordinate bounds.

wknn_HS.label: WKNN(H+S)
wknn_HS.training_information: No learned source model. Matching uses all deployment H and current S.

tabicl.label: Public TabICL
tabicl.training_information: Public pretrained checkpoint, zero project source-training updates. Deployment context is full H and current S. Public pretraining corpus is not audited.

scaml.label: ScaML-GP (RSS-to-coordinate adaptation)
scaml.training_information: Official ScaML core with the corrected restart-selection adapter. Source GPs fit the deployment H, target GP fits S. Extra UJI training buildings are unused.

pretrain_dnn.label: Supervised DNN, no target gradient update
pretrain_dnn.training_information: Project RSS-to-coordinate DNN trained on current building H. Hyperparameters selected on the other UJI buildings. H/S determine AP axis and coordinate normalization.

finetune_dnn.label: Supervised DNN + S fine-tuning
finetune_dnn.training_information: Project RSS-to-coordinate DNN trained on current building H, then all parameters fine-tuned on S. Hyperparameters selected on the other UJI buildings.

maml_dnn.label: First-order MAML (RSS regression)
maml_dnn.training_information: Project first-order MAML using history-floor support/query episodes from current building H, then S adaptation. Hyperparameters selected on the other UJI buildings.

refi.label: ReFi learning path
refi.training_information: Five-seed relationship learner trained on the other two UJI buildings. Deployment uses current building H and S. This row is the learning-only component.

retained_gp.label: ReFi GP path
retained_gp.training_information: Base/observation parameters calibrated on UJI B1 for target B0 and UJI B0 for target B1/B2. Full deployment H builds historical fields; S estimates source weights/intercept and conditions the field.

refi_GP.label: ReFi (complete)
refi_GP.training_information: The heldout-building relation learner and retained GP path use the same H/S/Q, combined by the frozen equal log-pooling rule.

comparison_condition: Shared deployment H/S/Q task protocol. Training assets and source calibration differ as declared for each method. refi and retained_gp are internal component rows; refi_GP is the complete method.
